name: superbased-observer
description: Claude Code cost tracking, Cursor token usage, Codex spend — AI coding agent observability across 40 adapters (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline + Cline CLI, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Hermes Agent, Kilo Code, Aider, Goose, Devin, and more), proxy-accurate. No telemetry. No cloud.
author: Santosh Kathira <contact@superbased.app>

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, SuperBased will not resolve or spawn the observer daemon binary. observer.binary.path and observer.binary.preferPathBinary are restricted (machine scope) so a workspace cannot point the extension at an arbitrary executable.

commands.title: SuperBased: Enable MCP for this project

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with SuperBased
walkthroughs.description: Connect SuperBased to your AI coding workflow in about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Welcome to SuperBased
steps.description:
SuperBased captures, normalises, and analyses every AI coding tool's activity — locally, with no telemetry.
[Open Sidebar](command:workbench.view.extension.observer)

steps.title: Verify your install
steps.description:
Run `SuperBased: Doctor` to confirm the binary is resolved and the daemon's DB / hooks / MCP registrations are all healthy.
[Run SuperBased: Doctor](command:observer.doctor)

steps.title: Pick a daemon mode
steps.description:
Decide whether the extension attaches to a daemon you start manually (`detect`, default), spawns + supervises its own (`managed`), or auto-detects (`auto`).
[Open observer.daemon.mode setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22observer.daemon.mode%22)

steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.description:
The full React analytics dashboard renders inside an editor tab. Same surface as the standalone http://127.0.0.1:8081/.
[Open Dashboard](command:observer.openDashboard)

steps.title: Route AI CLIs through the proxy
steps.description:
Use the contributed terminal profile, or copy the proxy env vars to your existing terminal. Accurate token counts only work when the AI CLI talks to 127.0.0.1:8820.
[Copy Proxy Env Vars](command:observer.copyProxyEnv)

steps.title: Auto-update your instruction files
steps.description:
Open a `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or `.cursorrules` to see two CodeLenses at the top. Preview composes SuperBased's suggestions into a side editor; Refresh materialises them into the file.
[Run SuperBased: Preview Instruction Suggestions](command:observer.previewInstructions)

steps.title: You're set
steps.description:
SuperBased is wired into VS Code. The full user guide covers per-AI-tool workflows.
[Open Dashboard](command:observer.openDashboard)

observer.daemon.mode.description: How the extension manages the observer daemon. 'auto' (default) attaches to a daemon you already started, and otherwise spawns one — and only ever stops a daemon it spawned itself. 'managed' behaves the same. 'detect' attaches only and never spawns, so the views stay empty until you run `observer start` yourself.

observer.binary.path.description: Absolute path to the observer binary. Empty = auto-detect (bundled, then PATH, then download). Set observer.binary.preferPathBinary to scan PATH before the bundled binary. Machine-scoped and restricted in untrusted workspaces: a cloned repo's .vscode/settings.json cannot choose which binary this extension spawns.

observer.binary.preferPathBinary.description: Scan PATH for an observer binary before using the bundled one; slower activation, use when you intentionally run a self-built daemon. Machine-scoped and restricted in untrusted workspaces for the same reason as observer.binary.path.

observer.dashboard.port.description: Local port the observer dashboard listens on.

observer.proxy.port.description: Local port the observer API proxy listens on.

observer.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the today-spend status bar item.

observer.statusBar.wordmark.description: Prefix the today-spend status bar text with the SuperBased wordmark (▞ superbased).

observer.cacheStatusBar.enabled.description: Show the cache-expiry status bar item (a countdown that appears when a valuable prompt cache is about to go cold).

observer.loc.reportSaves.description: Report how many lines you changed when you save a file, so the dashboard can show human-written lines next to AI-written ones. Only LINE COUNTS leave the editor - how many code, comment, blank and whitespace-only lines changed. File content is never read, sent, or stored: no lines, no excerpts, no filenames beyond the workspace-relative path. Counts go to the local observer daemon on loopback (127.0.0.1) and nowhere else. Generated and vendored files (lockfiles, node_modules, dist, *.pb.go) are skipped entirely.

observer.loc.editorToken.description: Token sent as X-Observer-Token when reporting saved line counts. Leave empty: the daemon generates a per-install token on first start and the extension reads it from the observer home (loc-editor-token, or OBSERVER_HOME if you set that). Fill this in only when the daemon runs somewhere the extension cannot read that file, or when you moved it with the [loc].editor_token_file config key.

observer.apiToken.markdownDeprecationMessage: No longer read. The only request that ever sent this header was the saved-line-count report; it now uses `#observer.loc.editorToken#` and the daemon's generated token file.
observer.apiToken.deprecationMessage: No longer read. Use observer.loc.editorToken instead.
observer.apiToken.description: Deprecated and no longer read by any request. The saved-line-count report now uses observer.loc.editorToken, falling back to the token file the daemon generates in the observer home.
